preconditions: P5.1 implementation installed on a disposable Odoo 18 database
cron enabled with at least two worker slots
gates.data: two long read-only prompts in separate conversations; no Odoo mutation
gates.injection: none; real browser, durable queue and provider path
gates.action: start Chat A, navigate away while unresolved, create Chat B, submit B, inspect both history entries and return to A
gates.backend_expected: A and B have distinct durable turn/conversation ids and neither navigation nor late callbacks create a second A turn
gates.browser_expected: history/new-chat navigation remains enabled while A is unresolved; A and B messages/runtime labels remain scoped to their conversations
gates.redaction: no raw provider payload, hidden reasoning, unrestricted arguments/results or credentials are recorded
gates.cleanup: cancel unresolved read-only turns and drop disposable database/filestore after the validation batch

preconditions: Codex model catalog exposes at least one selectable model
gates.user: internal disposable test user with normal Assistant preferences
gates.data: read-only long Turn A followed by read-only Turn B
gates.injection: change model and autonomy selectors through the real Assistant UI while A is unresolved
gates.action: read A's persisted reasoning_model/policy_payload, change selectors, re-read A, then enqueue B and inspect B's persisted snapshot
gates.backend_expected: A's stored snapshot remains byte/field-equivalent for model and user policy layer; B captures the newly selected values
gates.browser_expected: model/autonomy controls remain enabled while A runs and the new selections are usable for a new conversation
gates.redaction: only bounded preference and turn snapshot fields are inspected; prompts/provider internals are not persisted as evidence
gates.cleanup: restore original user model/autonomy preferences, cancel unresolved turns and drop disposable database/filestore after the batch

gates.injection: close and reopen the Assistant panel while the durable turn is unresolved
gates.action: count real /turn submissions, close panel, allow server work to continue, reopen panel and inspect the same conversation/turn
gates.backend_expected: the original turn remains the only submitted turn and does not become cancelled solely because the panel closed
gates.browser_expected: reopen restores the same conversation state without resubmitting/restarting the request
gates.redaction: no provider-private output is recorded; only turn id/state and browser-visible state are checked
gates.cleanup: cancel the read-only turn if still unresolved and drop disposable database/filestore after the batch
